projection: ORTHOGRAPHIC front, dead-on (no tilt, no yaw)
howToInvertAMark: u = px/res - 0.5 ; v = 0.5 - py/res ; world x = centre.x + u*orthoScale ; world z = centre.z + v*orthoScale ; then raycast from (x, min.y - 1, z) along +Y onto the mesh. This is exactly what measure_face.py stage 3 does, so the return path is proven.
pose: REST -- every shape key zeroed and every bone cleared, so marks land on where features ARE rather than where a pose put them
